tools.name: get_campaigns
tools.description: Lists existing lemlist campaigns, e.g. to audit what is already running.

tools.name: get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Returns performance metrics for a lemlist campaign.

tools.name: lemleads_search
tools.description: Searches the lemlist B2B lead database by role, industry, company size and location to find prospects matching an ideal customer profile.

tools.name: findEmail
tools.description: Finds a lead's email address. Consumes credits.

tools.name: verifyEmail
tools.description: Verifies an email address before it is used in a campaign. Consumes credits.

tools.name: linkedinEnrichment
tools.description: Enriches a lead using LinkedIn data. Consumes credits.

tools.name: findPhone
tools.description: Finds a lead's phone number. Consumes credits.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Generic fallback that calls any lemlist API endpoint outside the advertised tool set.
